data.description: Represents information about a deposit account.

accountHolderKey.description: The encoded key of the account holder, which is an individual client or group.

accountState.description: The state of the deposit account.

accountType.description: The deposit account type and the product that it belongs to.

accruedAmounts.description: Represents information about the accrued amounts of deposit accounts.

interestAccrued.description: The amount of positive interest that has been accrued in the account.

negativeInterestAccrued.description: The amount of negative interest that has been accrued in the account.

overdraftInterestAccrued.description: The amount of overdraft interest that has been accrued in the account.

technicalOverdraftInterestAccrued.description: The amount of technical overdraft interest that has been accrued in the account.

activationDate.description: The date when the deposit account was activated, in the organization's timezone and time format.

approvedDate.description: The date when the deposit account was approved, in the organization's timezone and time format.

assignedBranchKey.description: The key of the branch that this deposit account is assigned to.

assignedCentreKey.description: The key of the centre that this account is assigned to.

assignedUserKey.description: The key of the user that this deposit is assigned to.

balances.description: Represents information about the balances of a deposit account.

availableBalance.description: The current available balance for deposit transactions.

blockedBalance.description: The sum of all the blocked amounts on an account.

feesDue.description: The amount of fees due to be paid on this account.

forwardAvailableBalance.description: The sum of all the authorization hold amounts that have `CRDT` as the `creditDebitIndicator` for an account.

holdBalance.description: The sum of all the authorization hold amounts that have `DBIT` as the `creditDebitIndicator` for an account.

lockedBalance.description: The locked amount that is not available for withdrawal in the account. For more information, see [Deposit Account Overview Details](https://docs.mambu.com/docs/deposit-account-overview-details/).

overdraftAmount.description: The overdraft amount that has been taken out in the account. For more information, see [Overdraft Products](https://docs.mambu.com/docs/overdraft-products).

overdraftInterestDue.description: The amount of interest due to be paid on an account as a result of an authorized overdraft.

technicalOverdraftAmount.description: The technical overdraft amount that has been taken out in the account. For more information, see [Technical Overdraft](https://docs.mambu.com/docs/overdraft-products/#technical-overdraft).

technicalOverdraftInterestDue.description: The amount of interest due to be paid on an account as a result of a technical overdraft.

totalBalance.description: The current balance of the account.

closedDate.description: The date when the deposit account was closed, in UTC.

courtesyPaySettings.description: Represents information about a deposit account's courtesy settings.

allowCourtesyPay.description: `TRUE` if this account supports courtesy, `FALSE` otherwise.

courtesyPayLimit.description: The maximum amount that may be covered under courtesyPay. Always display even if courtesyPay is disabled.

creationDate.description: The date this deposit account was created, in UTC.

creditArrangementKey.description: The key to the credit arrangement where this account is registered.

encodedKey.description: The encoded key of the deposit account, which is auto-generated and unique.

id.description: The ID of the deposit account, which can be generated and customized - but must be unique.

interestSettings.description: Represents information about the deposit account's interest settings.

interestPaymentSettings.description: Represents information about the interest payment settings.

interestPaymentDates.description: The list of all dates when the interest is paid into the deposit account.

items.description: Wrapper for month and day for instances where the year isn't needed

interestPaymentPoint.description: The interest payment point, which specifies when the interest should be paid to the account.

interestRateSettings.description: Represents information about the interest rate settings for deposit accounts.

encodedKey.description: The encoded key for the set of interest settings, which is auto-generated and unique.

interestChargeFrequency.description: The interest change frequency method for a loan account. Shows the possible methods for obtaining the balance based on which the interest will be calculated for loan repayment.

interestChargeFrequencyCount.description: The number of times to apply interest in a time period.

interestRate.description: The interest rate for the deposit account.

interestRateReviewCount.description: The number of times to review the interest rate in a time period.

interestRateTerms.description: The terms for how interest rate is determined when accruing for an account.

endingBalance.description: The top-limit value for the account balance in order to determine if this tier is used or not

interestRate.description: The rate used for computing the interest for an account which has the balance less than the ending balance

interestSpread.description: The index interest rate that is used to calculate the interest rate that is applied to accounts.

maxDepositBalance.description: The maximum deposit balance of the account.

maxWithdrawalAmount.description: The maximum amount allowed for a withdrawal.

recommendedDepositAmount.description: The recommended amount for a deposit.

targetAmount.description: The target amount for a deposit made towards a savings goal.

lastAccountAppraisalDate.description: The date when the account was last evaluated for interest calculations and maturity, in the organization's timezone and time format.

lastInterestCalculationDate.description: The date when interest was last calculated for the account, in the organization's timezone and time format.

lastInterestReviewDate.description: The date when regular interest was last reviewed, in the organization's timezone and time format.

encodedKey.description: The encoded key of the group role name, which is auto generated, and unique.

groupRoleKey.description: A role which describes the intended use of a group in the system.

homePhone.description: The home phone number associated with the group.

id.description: The ID of the group, which can be generated and customized, but must be unique.

lastModifiedDate.description: The last date the group was updated.

loanCycle.description: Number of paid and closed (with 'obligations met') accounts for this client. When the closing operation is reverted, this is reduced.

migrationEventKey.description: The migration event encoded key associated with this group.

mobilePhone.description: The mobile phone number associated with the group.

notes.description: Extra notes about this group.

preferredLanguage.description: The preferred language associated with the group (used for the notifications).

next_cursor.description: Continuation value, or empty at the end.

description: Read and manage Mambu clients and groups, and retrieve banking accounts, products and branches.

mambu_new_branch_trigger.description: New branch after the first complete scan. Existing records form the initial baseline; polling resumes after a restart. Scans exceeding 4,000 records stop without advancing the saved place.

mambu_new_group_trigger.description: New group after the first complete scan. Existing records form the initial baseline; polling resumes after a restart. Scans exceeding 4,000 records stop without advancing the saved place.
